inputs.name: atomicComponents.options
inputs.description: Supply it when calling the wrapper with preprocessor options; the wrapper forwards it unchanged to the imported atomic preprocessor. The only declared field is optional aliases, a record of string keys and values.

outputs.name: atomicComponents
outputs.description: The PreprocessorGroup returned directly from the imported atomic preprocessor. It is the Svelte build integration value produced by this wrapper; this file defines no further shape or behavior.
